system.description:
Made with the Elven Bowcraft skill. Bigger than hunting bows but not as big as great bows of men. 3D range dice at optimal and extreme; maximum range 250 paces. In Fight, Nock and Draw time of five actions.

Arrows (choose when purchasing): Hunting Head I: B4, M: B8, S: B11, VA 2 (free); Leaf Head I: B5, M: B9, S: B12, VA 1 (+1 rp); Bodkin I: B4, M: B7, S: B10, VA 3 (+2 rps). Stats here are for the Hunting Head.

Elven characters with four or fewer lifepaths whose last lifepath is Elven Bowyer may take an Elven Bow for 5 rps.

DoF modifiers: exceed obstacle +1, double obstacle +2, triple obstacle +3; extreme range -1 to the DoF.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 156
